prompt:
Theme: Evening rooftop before the opening of a temple fair, a clearly adult female showing a cyan-green lion dance head diagonally towards the camera, the hem of her clothes and the tassels of the lion head being blown by the wind at the same time, freezing the second before the appearance.
Subject: A clearly adult Oriental female enters the shot in full body, forming a main visual relationship with a complete cyan-green lion dance head.

Character · Expression: Confident, bright, cheerful, looking at the camera, with the excitement of the upcoming performance.
Clothing · Pose: Peacock blue Chinese-style short jacket, with gold piping and cloud pattern embroidery, cream-white pleated long skirt, cyan-green hair ribbon, adorned with a narrow coral orange tie at the waist. The left foot takes half a step forward, the right hand supports the center of the bottom of the lion head, the left hand supports the side edge, arms are complete and continuous, the lion head is close to the body and has a sense of weight.

Background · Lighting: City old street rooftop temple fair, with wooden drum frames, golden gongs, layered building clusters, and sparse red lanterns as environmental details. Sunset shines from the back right, warm gold rim light outlines the character, clothing edges, and the fur edges of the lion head, face is brightened by environmental reflections.
Composition · Lens: 35mm slightly low-angle full-body environmental portrait, the character is on the right side, the lion head as the lower-left foreground subject, forming a visual diagonal line extending to the character's chest.

Texture · Style: Color movie film texture, cyan-green and warm gold colors are clearly separated, slight grain and highlight blooming, retaining real skin texture and natural motion sense.
Negative: Extra people, multiple lion dances, extra arms, double joints, broken wrists, lion head floating, black and white development, garbled text, brand logos.
